Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner arrived at an incorrect conclusion by interpreting the country of origin based solely on titles ("Scottish peerage") without properly considering the birthplace (England). This mistake stems from over-reliance on the association of titles with national identity, without recognizing that birthplace (England) takes precedence in determining the country of origin in the provided genealogical context. The assumption that being part of the Scottish peerage equates to being "from Scotland" led to a flawed conclusion.
